ESAT Mock Practice — Bingkun Qi

Practise by topic, review the explanation, then use mistakes and primary-topic statistics to choose the next round of practice.

About this project

Practice should offer more than a score. I want students to revisit how they reached an answer: which judgement was rushed, which relationship was unclear, and what they could practise next.

The project connects practice, mock exams, explanations, mistakes and topics. Students can start with a question, review the method, then choose further practice on its primary topic. Teachers can also use that sequence to discuss the next revision step.

Features and use cases

  • Choose practice by subject, topic or primary topic
  • Review answer feedback and available explanations after responding
  • Use random papers or mock-paper series within one subject
  • Revisit mistakes and continue with related questions
  • Use primary-topic statistics to choose what to practise next

From one answer to the next useful practice session.

The learning question

After finding out whether an answer is correct, a student still needs to understand the method and decide what to work on next.

Ways to practise

Start with a topic, or choose a random paper or a mock-paper series within one subject.

Clues for review

Consider mistakes alongside results by primary topic, then choose a specific focus for the next session.

Choose and answer

Enter practice through a subject or topic. Make your own judgement, submit an answer, then review the feedback.

Review the reasoning

Open the available explanation and compare the key relationships and calculations with your approach. Revisit your original choice in the mistakes view.

Choose a topic and try again

Use the statistics page to review results by primary topic. Select an area that needs more practice and follow its practice link to a relevant question set.

This walkthrough contains no real student records. Questions and explanations carry source labels; explanations are still being added for some questions.
